continuity.B01: Kabir returns at 03:00; dialogue present exactly as supplied in source document

sections.title: Kabir returns home
paragraphs: Raat ke teen baje door dheere se khula. Kabir andar aaya. Laptop bag utarte hue usne ghadi dekhi — 3:02. Production issue resolve ho chuka tha, lekin thakaan uske chehre aur body pe saaf dikh rahi thi.
Bedroom mein Ankita so rahi thi. Kabir ne dheere se kapde side pe rakhe. Bed ke paas aaya toh Ankita ki aankhein khuli.
**Ankita:** “Kabir… aa gaye?”
**Kabir:** “Haan, baby. So jao. Sorry, jaga diya.”

Ankita ne aankhein malte hue uska haath pakda aur apni taraf khincha. Woh bed pe baith gaya. Ankita ne uske gaal pe kiss kiya, phir honthon pe. Kiss dheere se gehra hua. Uske haath Kabir ke chest pe gaye.
**Kabir:** “Itni raat ko bhi?”
**Ankita:** “Tumhare liye koi timing hai kya?”

Woh muskuraaya. Ankita ne usse gale lagaya. Uski chuchiyan Kabir ke chest se press hui. Kabir ne uske back pe haath rakha, phir dheere se neeche waist pe. Ankita ne apna body uske against chipka diya. Uske andar se garam sa ehsaas aa raha tha. Neeche se bhi halki si heat.
Kabir ne uske honthon pe ek aur kiss kiya, lekin uski saans thaki hui thi.
**Kabir:** “Baby… aaj sach mein bahut thak gaya hoon.”
Ankita ne uski aankhon mein dekha. Thakaan clearly dikh rahi thi.
**Ankita:** “Pata hai. Tumhari aankhein bata rahi hain.”
**Kabir:** “Kal jaldi aaunga. Promise.”
**Ankita:** “Kal nahi. Aaj. Date badal chuki hai.”
Kabir hasa. Ankita ne uski neck pe ek aur soft kiss kiya. Uske haath Kabir ke chest se neeche slide hue, lekin usne ruk gaya. Kabir ne uska haath pakad ke upar le aaya.
**Kabir:** “Aaj nahi, baby. Kal poora time dunga.”

Ankita ne kuch nahi kaha. Usne usse gale lagaye rakha. Kabir fresh hone gaya, phir wapas aaya. Dono ek doosre ke paas let gaye. Ankita ne uske against apna body rakha. Kabir ki saans dheere dheere gehri hone lagi.

Ankita abhi jaag rahi thi. Uske andar thodi aur nazdeeki ki ichha thi. Chuchiyon mein halki si tightness, neeche bhi restlessness. Lekin usse pata tha Kabir ko aaram chahiye. Usne uske forehead se baal hataye aur aankhein band kar li.
*Aaj shaam tumhe itni aasani se sone nahi dungi,* usne socha.
Room mein khamoshi ho gayi.

sections.title: Morning wake-up
paragraphs: 6:30 AM. Ankita uthi; Kabir gehri neend mein tha. Usne morning walk shaam ke liye shift ki aur apne routine kaam shuru kar diye.

sections.title: Filter maintenance call
paragraphs: Kitchen mein filter ka band valve dekhkar use kal ki pending repair yaad aayi. Usne Rinku ko call karke replacement connector ka status poochha. Rinku ne kaha ki woh maintenance check ke liye 7:15 tak aa jayega; exact replacement abhi pending tha.

sections.title: Yesterday's reaction
paragraphs: Call rakhte hi Ankita ko kal Rinku ki achanak khamoshi yaad aayi. Is baar woh uski reaction samajhna chahti thi—aur usne decide kiya ki aaj ki mulaqat ko sirf ek ordinary repair visit nahi rehne degi.

sections.title: The wardrobe decision
paragraphs: Ankita bathroom mein jaakar mirror ke saamne rukti hai. Woh consciously apne innerwear aur nightdress ki presentation par decision leti hai, phir dusty-rose nighty mein wapas aati hai. Reader ko clear rehta hai ki aaj ka outfit choice deliberate hai, accidental nahi.

sections.title: The Deliberate First Show
paragraphs: Rinku kitchen counter ke paas apne tools rakh kar replacement connector ki baat kar raha tha.
Rinku: “Madam, exact part abhi nahi aaya. Shaam tak mil jana chahiye.”
Rinku ne band valve check kiya, connector ki fitting dekhi aur required size note kar liya.
Ankita ne sir hilaya. Usne notice kiya ki Rinku aaj usse bilkul normal tareeke se baat kar raha tha.
Kal toh achanak chup ho gaya tha. Aaj kya hua?
Usne counter pe rakhe paani ke container ki taraf dekha. Kuch pal sochti rahi, phir ek aisa faisla kiya jo uski normal morning routine ka hissa nahi tha.
Ankita ne khud paani apne upar daala.

Paani uske baalon se hota hua kandhon aur dusty-rose nighty pe behne laga. Kuch hi seconds mein nighty poori tarah bheeg chuki thi. Halki satin ka rang gehra ho gaya aur pehle loose dikhne wala kapda ab uske body ke bilkul close aa gaya. Fabric chipak gaya.
Rinku ne uski taraf dekha. Ankita ko apni wardrobe choice pata thi, lekin Rinku uske kapdon ke neeche ki exact state confirm nahi kar sakta tha.
Fabric transparent nahi tha. Wet nighty ki fit aur silhouette badli hui thi, lekin har anatomical detail clearly visible nahi thi.
Rinku: “Madam… yeh kya kiya aapne?”
Ankita ne turant jawab nahi diya.

Counter ke paas paani gira tha. Woh ek kapda uthane ke liye neeche jhuki. Nighty ki folds aur neckline uske movement ke saath badal gayi. Uski shoulders, neckline pe upper cleavage aur waist ki outline pehle se zyada clear dikh rahi thi.
Jab woh jhuki, nighty ki folds aur neckline dobara shift hui. Rinku ka dhyaan us movement par ruk gaya.

Rinku ka haath tool pouch pe hi ruk gaya. Uski nazar Ankita ke bent body pe atki hui thi. Woh uski badli appearance notice kar raha tha, lekin andar ki exact clothing state uske liye confirmed nahi thi.
Ankita ne upar dekha.
Ankita: “Kya hua, Rinku?”
Ek pal ke liye dono ki nazrein mili.
Rinku: “Kuch nahi, madam… main part aate hi bata dunga.”
Usne tools samete. Ankita seedhi khadi hui, paani ab bhi nighty se tapak raha tha.
Rinku ne ek baar uski taraf dekha, phir darwaze ki taraf badha.
Rinku: “Shaam ko update kar dunga.”
Ankita wahi khadi reh gayi.
Is baar usse pata tha ki paani achanak nahi gira tha. Usne khud yeh decision liya tha.
Lekin Rinku ne actually kya samjha?
B06 ends.
